purpose: Source-routing registry for widening geographic and medium coverage. A catalog entry is not evidence that its data are bundled, open for redistribution, or scientifically interchangeable with another entry.

status_definitions.bundled: Official data or a value-independent derivative is frozen and hash-verified in the offline benchmark.
status_definitions.runtime_candidate: Official access is known, but an adapter, stable bulk export, or license check is still required.
status_definitions.discovery_only: Useful for locating national or project data; it is not itself a normalized observation feed.
status_definitions.restricted: Access or redistribution constraints prevent default bundling or exact-point publication.

sources.name: TPDC China mountain soil multi-element dataset
sources.access: Official no-login archive endpoint plus metadata API
sources.license_or_terms: TPDC attribution terms; share policy A; no standard license identifier stated
sources.benchmark_role: All 1,314 observations; Cr, Cu, Ni, Pb and Zn
sources.scientific_boundary: Thirty mountain regions and three horizons are not a uniform national grid.

sources.name: China Geological Survey GeoCloud
sources.access: Dataset-dependent portal access; bulk download and redistribution terms must be checked per item
sources.benchmark_role: High-priority runtime adapter candidate for national and regional products
sources.scientific_boundary: Do not scrape, redistribute, or expose exact coordinates without dataset-specific permission.

sources.name: Geochemical Map of Japan
sources.license_or_terms: Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use 2.0 / compatible with CC BY 4.0
sources.benchmark_role: Value-independent 600-sample slice; seven target elements
sources.scientific_boundary: Per-analyte method is documented in the atlas rather than repeated in the CSV.

sources.name: AfSIS Phase I archived soil wet chemistry
sources.benchmark_role: At most 40 samples per country-depth; small groups retained completely
sources.scientific_boundary: Aqua-regia quasi-total chemistry is not interchangeable with total digestion or XRF.

sources.name: PANGAEA North African deflatable soil fractions
sources.benchmark_role: All Table S5 observations; six target elements
sources.scientific_boundary: Dust-provenance fine fractions are not a general agricultural-soil baseline; border samples are not forced into one country.

sources.name: Soils4Africa continental soil sampling
sources.license_or_terms: Exact sampling-location visibility is restricted by the Soils4Africa license agreement
sources.benchmark_role: Aggregation-only runtime candidate; not bundled
sources.scientific_boundary: Never publish exact points by default; enforce the current license before any map export.

sources.name: ISRIC soil geographic databases for Africa
sources.benchmark_role: Soil-context and covariate discovery
sources.scientific_boundary: Many products are soil classes or predicted properties rather than raw trace-element observations.

sources.name: FOREGS Geochemical Atlas of Europe
sources.access: Official ZIP archives with CSV and Excel files
sources.license_or_terms: FOREGS/EuroGeoSurveys/GTK attribution and copyright terms; no standard SPDX identifier
sources.benchmark_role: Topsoil, subsoil, humus, stream water, stream sediment and floodplain sediment; capped per country-medium
sources.scientific_boundary: Below-DL values were replaced upstream by DL/2 and original censor qualifiers cannot be recovered.

sources.name: GEOROC global rock geochemistry
sources.access: Dataverse precompiled files and official API
sources.license_or_terms: CC BY-SA 4.0 for bundled precompiled products
sources.benchmark_role: Value-independent craton and Antarctic derivatives
sources.scientific_boundary: Literature density and method metadata vary; coordinate datum is not declared in the bundled CSVs.

sources.name: EarthChem data access federation
sources.benchmark_role: Broaden global rock and petrology discovery beyond bundled GEOROC slices
sources.scientific_boundary: Repository results require per-dataset license, method, duplicate and sample-identity handling.

sources.name: GEMAS European agricultural soil
sources.benchmark_role: All 2,113 agricultural-land records from the selected layer
sources.scientific_boundary: Aqua-regia values and coarse sampling density do not resolve local mineralization.

sources.name: UNEP GEMS/Water Global Freshwater Quality Archive
sources.benchmark_role: Value-independent 35-country target-element slice
sources.scientific_boundary: Methods, fractions, purposes and dates are heterogeneous; restricted-policy records are excluded.

sources.name: GEOTRACES Intermediate Data Product 2025
sources.benchmark_role: Future ocean trace-element adapter
sources.scientific_boundary: Marine dissolved/particulate fractions must not be merged with freshwater or solid-media observations.

sources.name: National Geochemical Survey of Australia
sources.access: Geoscience Australia downloads and catalog APIs
sources.license_or_terms: Dataset-specific; bundled Hg product is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 Australia
sources.benchmark_role: All 2,396 Hg determinations from the bundled product; other NGSA elements are runtime candidates
sources.scientific_boundary: Top and bottom outlet sediments and grain fractions must remain distinguished.

sources.name: Canadian Database of Geochemical Surveys
sources.access: Survey catalog with standardized spreadsheet and KML downloads
sources.benchmark_role: High-priority adapter for North American non-rock media
sources.scientific_boundary: Survey-specific methods and overlapping samples require provenance-aware deduplication.

sources.name: USGS geochemical datasets and National Geochemical Database products
sources.access: ScienceBase, data releases, Water Quality Portal and product-specific downloads
sources.license_or_terms: Usually US Government public domain; verify each product
sources.benchmark_role: Existing D2 real-data laboratory contains small USGS/WQP fixtures; not part of the expanded global profile
sources.scientific_boundary: No single USGS endpoint is a uniform national multi-medium schema.

sources.name: Brazil Geological Survey GeoSGB open data
sources.access: Open-data portal; GEOQ geochemical analysis layer
sources.license_or_terms: Verify the selected bulk export and attribution terms
sources.benchmark_role: High-priority South American coverage candidate
sources.scientific_boundary: A stable, license-verified bulk export and field dictionary are required before bundling.

sources.name: Colombian Geological Survey geochemical atlas
sources.license_or_terms: Verify redistribution terms for each atlas product
sources.benchmark_role: Small-file regional visualization and South American gap candidate
sources.scientific_boundary: KMZ map layers may contain cartographic products rather than row-level laboratory observations.

sources.name: PETLAB New Zealand petrology database
sources.benchmark_role: Oceania rock and petrology expansion
sources.scientific_boundary: Sample and analysis records require method-aware joins and license verification.

sources.name: IUGS Global Geochemical Baselines national atlas index
sources.access: Curated links to national atlas projects
sources.benchmark_role: Discovery route for small countries that global aggregators underrepresent
sources.scientific_boundary: Atlas availability does not imply machine-readable data or redistribution permission.

sources.name: PANGAEA Data Publisher for Earth & Environmental Science
sources.access: DOI landing pages, tab exports and ZIP collections
sources.license_or_terms: Dataset-specific, commonly explicit Creative Commons licenses
sources.benchmark_role: Targeted regional and small-country supplements with strong row-level DOI evidence
sources.scientific_boundary: Each dataset has a study-specific sampling design and cannot be treated as a uniform survey.
